name: comp-284
blurb: Red error banner with icon, message, action link, and close button.
description: Static error alert banner with CircleAlert icon, message text, optional action link, and dismissible close button. No interaction hooks.
use_when: You need to display persistent, dismissible error alerts with secondary actions that remain visible until closed.
avoid_when: For system-wide stacked notifications; use a toast system that queues messages instead.
a11y: Close button has aria-label; icons marked aria-hidden. No motion or animation.
